name: Robert Hernandez
headline: The Global Architect of Haunting Dark Surrealism & Anatomical Distortion
bio: Polish-born, Madrid-based Robert Hernandez is universally acknowledged as the undisputed forefather of dark, fine-art surrealism in contemporary tattooing. Discarding conventional stencils, Hernandez approaches human flesh like an oil painter with charcoal, carving twisted figures, haunting expressions, and organic shadow gradients directly onto the skin.
awards: Keynote Artist at Mondial du Tatouage Paris
